title: Where does the Sun go at night?
examples: Teacher, if the Earth turns, does that mean the Sun moves?
When it is dark, is the Sun really gone?
How does the Earth spinning make day and night?

explain.say: The Earth is a big ball. It spins all the time.

draw.text: Where does the Sun go at night?

explain.say: One whole spin takes one day. This spinning is called rotation.
When your side of the Earth faces the Sun, it is daytime.
The Earth keeps spinning. Your side turns away from the Sun.
Now the Sun shines on the other side of the Earth. There it is daytime.
At night, the Sun is still there. It is shining on the other side.

draw.text: Sun is on the other side

faq.q: If the Earth spins, does the Sun also spin?
faq.a: Yes, the Sun spins slowly too. But day and night come from the Earth spinning.
asks: Does the Sun move across the sky?
Is the Sun spinning with the Earth?

faq.q: Why do we have day and night if the Sun is always there?
faq.a: We have day and night because the Earth is always turning around. This spinning shows us different parts of the Earth.
asks: What makes it dark at night?
How does the Earth make day and night?

faq.q: Does the Sun ever go completely away?
faq.a: No. The Sun is always shining. It only seems to go away because the Earth turns.

faq.q: Is the Earth spinning faster or slower?
faq.a: The Earth spins at a steady speed all the time. This spinning causes the cycle of day and night.
asks: Does the Earth spin faster in the morning?
Is the Earth's spin speed constant?

faq.q: Does the Moon spinning affect the day and night?
faq.a: No, the Moon spinning does not cause day and night. The spinning of the Earth does that job.
asks: Does the Moon make it dark at night?
What causes the day and night cycle?

facts: The Earth spins on an imaginary line called an axis.
This spinning motion is called rotation.
Rotation causes the cycle of day and night.
The Sun is a star and does not move around the Earth.

options.show: the Sun moving around the Earth
options.say: the Sun moving around the Earth

quiz.why: The Earth spins. Your side faces the Sun, then turns away.

wrong.1: The Sun stays in its place, and the Earth is what turns.
wrong.2: The Moon goes around the Earth, but it makes no night for us.

quiz.say: In the morning, the Sun seems to come up. What is really happening?

options.show: your side turns to face the Sun
options.say: your side turns to face the Sun

quiz.why: The Earth spins. In the morning, your side turns to face the Sun.

wrong.0: The Sun shines all the time, so it needs no sleep.
wrong.2: The Sun stays the same size all day.

quiz.say: It is night where you live. Where is the Sun?
quiz.show: 🌙 Night time. Where is the Sun?

options.show: shining on the other side of the Earth
options.say: shining on the other side of the Earth

quiz.why: At night, your side faces away from the Sun. The Sun shines on the other side.

wrong.0: The Sun shines all the time, day and night.
wrong.1: The Moon is much smaller than the Sun, so it cannot hide it all night.
